neighbours.label: presentation verbs 'show(s)/provides/offers/gives' whose subject is a document, image, poll or design presenting content
fire: The latest poll from the newspaper shows the mayor losing support among young voters.
In the museum, a large mural shows the founding of the city by fishermen.
The survey of local farmers shows that most of them want better roads.
This chapter provides a short overview of the history of the railway.
The original map shows a single wall around the old market square.
The new guidebook offers practical advice for hiking in the mountains.
Last year's annual report gives a detailed account of the charity's spending.
On the left side, the photograph shows two children playing in the snow.
quiet: The latest poll from the newspaper was published on Monday after the debate.
In the museum, a large mural was damaged by water during the storm.
The survey of local farmers took three months and cost a lot of money.
This chapter was written in a hurry just before the book went to print.
The original map was found in a drawer of the old market office.
The new guidebook costs twelve dollars at most shops in the mountains.
Last year's annual report arrived late because the printer broke down.
On the left side, the photograph has faded after years in the sunlight.
